Execution order: Markdown step 5 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 28 (Markdown 04/12 — Preserve documents through storage conversion and backup). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Make Markdown an official target throughout shared design/task/QA retrieval, reference integrity and discovery rather than a file path mentioned in descriptions.
Scope:
- Extend target-type enumerations and shared resolution for task designSpecificationLinks, QA links and designExternalIds filters, design health, missing-reference diagnostics and reverse backlinks.
- Preserve ordered links and task/job version guards; resolve titles dynamically from canonical documents so renaming never breaks references.
- Return Markdown metadata in overview/inventory and relevant scopes; allow explicit Markdown identity retrieval with no C4 parent. Include project-level documents, linked architecture scopes and direct file/symbol bindings without recursively expanding all linked documents.
- Extend search and adashi_grep data projections to title/body matches with stable drillable locators; keep summary/page budgets and explicit truncation metadata.
- Opt-in task design scopes return complete relevant Markdown snapshots/tokens; normal task lists remain compact.
Acceptance:
- Tests on SQLite and text verify linking, scope drill-down, body search, file filtering, backlinks, rename stability, QA selection and guarded deletion.
- Existing element/relationship/UML/mockup links and task/QA history are unchanged.
- Native UI integration can consume typed identities without guessing kinds or relying on output paths.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 05/12 — Integrate design references, search and scope discovery
